Human

Restless, adaptable and fiercely invested in a life that never feels long enough.

Rules

Choose two of the five traits below. These are invitations to a familiar fantasy, not a required personality. Any ancestry may grow up in any culture.

Starting values: HP +2; base Speed 6.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.61b0d88447c2e217.JournalEntryPage.7ec549a88d2c0fd2]{Never Quite Finished} — There is always one more person to help, one more hill to cross. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.842bdbfabf5a03a8.JournalEntryPage.245562163cefc790]{Road in the Blood} — The horizon has never looked like a place to stop. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.9359afe57094a038.JournalEntryPage.3dbcab3603c8f263]{A Foot in Two Worlds} — You learned early that a stranger is sometimes only a person whose words you do not know. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.049752f9959c6e53.JournalEntryPage.c17d086cf4b23a5f]{Make Room at the Fire} — You can turn a cold greeting into a place at the table. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.68c8ac2592b5b5b3.JournalEntryPage.aacc4de0d7e4c5f2]{The Impossible Streak} — Someone says it cannot be done, and you hear a challenge.

Starting coin contribution: +1 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
